title: Egyptian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with lentils, exotic spices, and served with crispy flatbread.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, spice blend, cumin, coriander, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until lentils are tender.
Serve with flatbread on the side.
